name: South Gate Outpost
summary: Travelers stream through South Gate Outpost, a fortified post on the pass between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. Its mountaineers guard the southern road between Ironforge's frigid heights and the Loch's temperate valley.

sections.title: Watchers of the Southern Road
sections.body: South Gate Outpost marks the frontier between Dun Morogh's snowy slopes and Loch Modan's basin. Ironforge mountaineers patrol the rocky switchbacks and keep dangerous wildlife off the main highway. Unlike their hard-pressed kin at North Gate Outpost, these defenders have largely secured their stretch of road. Travelers, pilgrims, and trade wagons can journey toward Thelsamar in relative safety.

faq.q: What is the purpose of South Gate Outpost?
aliases: why is south gate outpost here
faq.answer: Mountaineers hold South Gate Outpost as a fortified border checkpoint and garrison along South Gate Pass. They keep the snowy road clear of mountain beasts and hostile interlopers traveling between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan.

faq.q: Why is it so much calmer here than at North Gate Outpost?
aliases: difference between north gate and south gate
faq.answer: The South Gate garrison has culled aggressive wildlife immediately bordering the road. North Gate Outpost faces heavier incursions and wilder mountain terrain, leaving the southern pass comparatively calm.

faq.q: Where does the road through South Gate Outpost lead?
faq.answer: Travel west up the pass into Dun Morogh's snowy highlands, toward Ironforge. Eastward, the road leads directly downhill into Loch Modan's temperate valley, then winds toward Thelsamar.

angles.text: For dwarves leaving Coldridge Valley and Dun Morogh for the first time, South Gate Outpost is the last chilly landmark before the descent into Loch Modan's vibrant, sunlit lands.

For the Alliance, South Gate Outpost offers a dependable military shelter along one of Khaz Modan's primary domestic supply lines, keeping the passage between the capital and eastern settlements open.
